body.text:
FROM: Site Physician
TO: Site Director
RE: Insomnia cluster, Floor 2

Fourteen staff on Floor 2 now report total sleep loss exceeding four days. Stimulant requests have tripled. Two researchers fell asleep mid-sentence and could not be woken for an hour, and both woke screaming about

.

I am aware of the standing explanation (stress, shift work). I no longer believe it. I requisitioned a thermal imaging unit from Security and walked the dormitory wing last night with it switched on.
I am not filing what I saw as an addendum. I am filing it as a containment breach report. There are at least two of them, and they were already in the room when I opened the door.
